blocks.note: Form ordinary comparative and relative-superlative structures with più or meno, then choose the lexical adjective or adverb form when meaning and grammatical function require it; the hygiene gate excludes the one judgment-dependent alternative answer.

Choose che where aligned alternatives imply the same predicate and subject, but di for a distinct comparison term, quantity, or articulated benchmark; retain comparative non as nonnegative when it belongs to a finite-clause comparator.
Replace molto plus an adjective or eligible adverb with an agreeing elative in -issimo, preserving the stem spelling and keeping elative intensity distinct from a relative superlative.
Build comparisons of equality with tanto/altrettanto quanto or così come, applying agreement when the correlatives quantify nouns and preserving the intended comparison domain.

Translate special comparison meanings by construction: extra quantities with in più/in meno, change in meglio/in peggio, urgency with convenire/dovere/bisogna, preference with preferire, superlative domains with di, and scalar progression with paired or repeated forms.
